articles.title: Donald Trump and JD Vance blame Iran war for midterm losses | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 唐纳德特朗普和JD万斯将中期损失归咎于伊朗战争| BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Donald Trump says it's "largely true" that the US-Israel war in Iran was responsible for sweeping Republican losses in the US midterm elections.
 
His comments come after US Vice-President, JD Vance, said in an social media post "the reason we lost is the war."

The President has said he has no plans for immediate strikes on Iran after the vote, but the region remains on alert for any further military action.
 
The BBC's International Editor, Jeremy Bowen - alongside colleagues from the United States and BBC Persian - provides analysis of what the midterm results mean for the war and where things might go from here.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#BBCNews

articles.readingTextZh:
唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）表示，美国-以色列在伊朗的战争是共和党在美国中期选举中大幅失败的原因，这“基本上是真的”。

他的评论是在美国副总统JD Vance在一篇社交媒体帖子中表示“我们失败的原因是战争”之后发表的。

总统表示，他没有在投票后立即对伊朗发动袭击的计划，但该地区仍对任何进一步的军事行动保持警惕。

英国广播公司的国际编辑杰里米·鲍恩（ Jeremy Bowen ）与来自美国和英国广播公司波斯语频道的同事一起，分析了中期结果对战争的意义以及未来的发展方向。

articles.title: Who's hacking supermarket fridges - and why? | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 谁在黑客入侵超市冰箱？为什么？ | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Fridges and freezers in supermarkets across Europe have been hit by a cyber-attack. Hackers managed to gain control and remotely turn up the temperature, in some cases to over 50 degrees Celsius, causing thousands of Euros worth of food to be thrown out. 

Rumours have been circulating online that Russian hacktivist groups could be to blame. 

So how did this happen? In this video:

1:27 Why are fridges connected to the internet?
2:02 How do you hack a fridge?
3:15 The aftermath of the supermarket hack
3:55 French blood banks targeted
4:42 Recent similar attacks 
5:22 Who is behind the hacking?
6:25 What else is vulnerable to these sorts of attacks?
7:21 How can we protect against these attacks?
8:00 Could AI make more of these attacks likely?
8:47 What does this tell us about the future of cyber-attacks?

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

#Supermarket #Hack #CyberCrime #Russia #AI #BBCNews

articles.title: 'Are you confused?' Dem & GOP reps erupt in shouting match over Congress
articles.titleZh: “你困惑吗？”民主党和共和党代表在国会大喊大叫
articles.summary:
While discussing Democrats’ potential impeachment efforts of the president and policymaking in Congress going forward, Republican Texas Rep. Dan Crenshaw and Democratic Maryland Rep. Jamie Raskin got into a heated shouting match.

“A little hard to believe the Democrats aren’t going to want to impeach Trump. It’s sort of a pastime, but who knows?” Crenshaw said in the exchange on CNN.

“It’s our pastime to defend the Constitution,” Raskin fired back.

0:00 Raskin on whether Democrats should pursue impeaching Trump
2:14 CNN's Manu Raju asks Hakeem Jeffries about how he will treat Trump
4:22 Raskin: "You're missing the point and you guys lost the election because you missed the point"
6:44 "You seem a little flustered, buddy." "I got 82% of the vote, I'm doing great today"
7:05 Crenshaw: "Are you capable of saying anything substantive, besides platitudes and talking points?"

Get live election results, analysis & more updates: https://cnn.it/48x1hqU

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

articles.title: Discussing death with Dr. Sanjay Gupta
articles.summary:
Discussing death can be one of the most difficult things to do with our families, but Dr. BJ Miller encourages us to tackle this important subject with loved ones, especially our children.

“It can be a joyful, enriching conversation… some families ritualize it, every year they talk about their advanced directives.”

Chasing Life with Dr. Sanjay Gupta is streaming on the CNN App and wherever you get your podcasts.
